newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding's Gut confident on 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding's Gut confident on 1996 profit.

text.p: CS Holding continues to expect to report higher profits for 1996 compared with the prior year, CS Holding Chairman Rainer Gut said.
"We are confident we will achieve a higher profit in 1996, but we are still dissatisfied about high provision requirements," Gut told shareholders at an extraordinary meeting.
However, Gut said in response to a shareholder's question that it was too early to talk about any specific numbers with regard to the group's third-quarter performance.
